subject.title: fix: tighten findSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer with execution guard

question: Should existing fractional `find` limits remain normalized for compatibility, or should OpenClaw intentionally reject them as invalid tool input and define the corresponding policy for sibling session tools?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but only maintainers can choose whether an existing model-tool and direct-execution behavior is a compatibility contract or an input error to remove.

options.title: Preserve normalization
options.body: Keep the current fractional-limit normalization behavior and close this contract-tightening change unless a concrete incorrect-result bug is demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt integer-only limits
options.body: Accept the compatibility change and define whether the same integer-only policy should be applied consistently to the related session tools.

recommendation.title: Preserve normalization
recommendation.body: Keep the current fractional-limit normalization behavior and close this contract-tightening change unless a concrete incorrect-result bug is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent branch work is concentrated in the execution coverage, though current-main feature ownership needs confirmation before a final product decision.
